evidence.ACL: Mucoid degeneration of the ACL, with early ganglion cyst formation within the distal insertion.
evidence.MCL: Thickening of the MCL with mild overlying edema in keeping with grade 1 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Degenerative multidirectional tear, with longitudinal horizontal tear at the junction of the body and posterior horn, and radial tear of the posterior horn.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Blunting of the inner free edge of the body of the lateral meniscus in keeping with a small partial radial tear
evidence.Medial OA: Full-thickness chondral loss at the medial femoral condyle, with diffuse high-grade medial articular cartilage thinning. Small marginal osteophytes in keeping with mild medial compartment osteoarthrosis.
evidence.Lateral OA: Mild partial-thickness chondral thinning of lateral articular cartilage.
evidence.PF OA: Full-thickness cartilage loss at the medial patellar articular facet with mild subchondral reactive edema. Small marginal osteophytes in keeping with mild osteoarthrosis.
